title: Re-Rate Credits of the Current Term on Cancellation — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
### Re-rate fraction (NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own))

On cancellation, each re-rate credit of the current term (risk premium and reserve fund assessment lines) is taken back in the re-rate fraction, judged on the applied Elevation Certificate most recently recorded and the date its rating change took effect:

| The certificate's rating change took effect | Re-rate fraction |
|---|---|
| After the cancellation date — the lower rating never applied | 1 |
| After the term start and on or before the cancellation date | The days from the cancellation date to the term end divided by the days from the rating change to the term end |
| Otherwise | The term share: the days from the cancellation date to the term end divided by the days of the current term |

Taking back a re-rate credit reduces the line's cancellation credit by that part of the credit.

*Hypothetical case.* A rating change effective with 300 days left, cancellation with 150 days left: the fraction is 150 over 300, one half.
